description: Codex's plans (written from codex-acp 2.2.2 source until G8a's recordings replace it; sources: src/CodexEventHandler.ts, dist/index.js:31324-31326, 31712-31723; src/CodexPlanStream.ts, dist/index.js:29738-29748; src/tool-calls/ClientCapabilities.ts, dist/index.js:39794): one turn with the checklist plan as a standard plan update, sent whatever the client advertises, then the plan updated, then a proposed plan as markdown plan_update; answered 'Planned.' and end_turn

note: turn/plan/updated becomes a standard plan update with every step, priority medium and inProgress as in_progress (src/CodexEventHandler.ts, dist/index.js:31324-31326, updatePlan at :31712-31723); no client capability gates it.
The same plan with its first step done: the whole list again (src/CodexEventHandler.ts, dist/index.js:31712-31723).

A proposed plan (a plan item's text) goes as a markdown plan_update to a client that advertises plan (src/CodexPlanStream.ts, dist/index.js:29738-29748, planUpdates at src/tool-calls/ClientCapabilities.ts, dist/index.js:39794), as Clauseo does; acp warns and shows nothing of it. Raw: SDK schema 1.11.0 knows plan_update only with its unstable features, which a build of fake_agent alone leaves out.
